Anthony Trollope, Cousin Henry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anthony-trollope/cousin-henry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anthony Trollope, the author, died 1882 (citizenship: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland).

First publication of the text used: 1879 (SE colophon: 'Cousin Henry was published in 1879 by Anthony Trollope.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1879, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1974.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts): the work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1882.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
